svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.3k stars in total, about 1.08k a year earlier, mostly from tools launched since then. mr boxington 474, aube 2027, fnox 2234, hk 1245, pitchfork 675, usage 1053, +5 more 589.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
